scope: local read-only source inspection, no late submission or old-contract update probe, no remote runtime attestation
findings: The contract predicates compare ctx.checkpoint_id with queue_cutoff; this is an authenticated proving source checkpoint, not actual inclusion time.
The inspected edge path checks source <= current checkpoint, historical checkpoint membership, current own start leaf and monotonic account checkpoint.

The inspected edge/planner excerpts show no maximum source-age or application validUntilCheckpoint enforcement. This is a finding about the inspected path, not a claim that no gateway/configuration rule exists.

Normal application broadcast retains its current-checkpoint window checks. A public SD-key holder can bypass the application wrapper; do not elevate those local checks to protocol inclusion deadlines.

A confirmed sealing/terminal vault transition changes its own anchor and defeats competing earlier-anchor admission proofs. Prior to that transition, queue_cutoff alone is not evidence of actual sealed-set inclusion before a future random revelation.
externalRequirements: Protocol/RPC owners: provide effective transaction freshness and actual-inclusion deadline rules, implementation/configuration and isolated late-old-source rejection evidence if strict wall-clock/inclusion deadlines are claimed.
Randomness team: authenticate actual finalized sealed-set inclusion and derive one fixed future beacon target; a proof source checkpoint alone cannot establish commit-before-reveal.
